name: Axiom
overview: Show LaunchDarkly flag changes as annotations on Axiom charts.
description: Send LaunchDarkly flag changes to Axiom as annotations, so each change shows on the charts of your datasets.
author: Axiom

formVariables.name: Axiom API token
formVariables.description: Enter an Axiom [API token](https://app.axiom.co/settings/api-tokens) that can create annotations.

formVariables.name: Axiom dataset
formVariables.description: Enter the Axiom dataset where flag changes show as annotations. To annotate more datasets, add one configuration for each dataset.

formVariables.name: Hide member details
formVariables.description: Don't send the name of the member who made the change. Annotations are org metadata that Axiom stores in the US, also for orgs on the EU edge.
